# Crowne Plaza by IHG Hotels & Resorts expands its Paris presence with the opening of Crowne Plaza Paris Marne-la-Vallée


The new 250-room destination hotel offers a premium nature-led retreat just 40 minutes from central Paris, where balance comes naturally.


Crowne Plaza Paris Marne-la-Vallée[download](https://www.ihgplc.com/~/media/Images/I/Ihg-Plc/images/news/2026/crowne-plaza-by-ihg-expands-its-paris-presence.jpg)


[download](https://www.ihgplc.com/~/media/Images/I/Ihg-Plc/images/news/2026/crowne-plaza-by-ihg-expands-its-paris-presence-img-01.jpg)


[download](https://www.ihgplc.com/~/media/Images/I/Ihg-Plc/images/news/2026/crowne-plaza-by-ihg-expands-its-paris-presence-img-02.jpg)


**PARIS, FRANCE – 24 September 2026 –** Crowne Plaza by IHG Hotels & Resorts, one of the world’s largest premium hotel brands and a pioneer in blended travel, today announces the opening of[Crowne Plaza Paris Marne-la-Vallée](https://www.ihg.com/crowneplaza/hotels/us/en/magny-le-hongre/parpm/hoteldetail?msockid=38913344074f6fc519562465063e6e98) , a new destination hotel for Crowne Plaza in France.


Nestled in Magny-le-Hongre, at the heart of Marne-la-Vallée, Crowne Plaza Paris Marne-la-Vallée spans 2.5 hectares of landscaped grounds, creating a true sense of escape while remaining just moments from Paris’ world-renowned theme parks and La Vallée Village, one of Europe’s leading addresses for luxury outlet shopping.


Combining contemporary design, premium amenities and Crowne Plaza's signature approach to blended travel, the hotel introduces a distinctive hospitality experience designed for both leisure and business travellers in one of Europe's most dynamic destinations.


The newly opened hotel features 250 guestrooms and suites, the majority overlooking Golf Paris Val d'Europe and its three 9-hole courses, designed to create an effortless balance between productivity and relaxation. Sustainability has been embedded throughout the renovation, from the careful selection of materials, including recycled elements in the headboards and carpets, to the integration of innovative technologies aimed at reducing environmental impact. Throughout the property, flexible and inviting spaces encourage connection, wellbeing and ease, reflecting the evolving expectations of today’s traveller.


Guests can enjoy three distinct dining experiences within the hotel. La Clairière offers Mediterranean-inspired cuisine in an elegant setting, while L’Orangerie, overlooking the terrace and gardens, provides a versatile dining environment bathed in natural daylight, serving breakfast and hosting special private events. Mystic Bar serves as the hotel’s vibrant all-day social hub, evolving naturally throughout the day from healthy morning options and light lunch snacks to after-work drinks and signature cocktails in the evening.


Wellbeing also sits at the heart of the experience at Crowne Plaza Paris Marne-la-Vallée. Facilities include an indoor heated swimming pool, a spa, a fully equipped indoor gym and a dedicated Yoga & Pilates space, creating opportunities for wellness retreats and restorative stays. Surrounded by expansive landscaped grounds, guests can enjoy walking trails and bicycle rentals, while nearby golf facilities and dedicated children’s play areas make the hotel an ideal destination for guests of all ages. Later this year will also see the arrival of padel courts, a fully equipped outdoor gym, pétanque and cinema experiences, with the outdoor swimming pool and bar scheduled to open in spring 2027.


Conveniently located in Marne-la-Vallée, the hotel is approximately seven to nine minutes from Marne-la-Vallée Chessy station and the region’s world-renowned theme parks via a complimentary shuttle service.


Guests also enjoy easy access to La Vallée Village, Val d'Europe and the wider Paris region, complemented by on-site parking and electric vehicle charging facilities.


“ *At Crowne Plaza Paris Marne-la-Vallée, we set out to create more than a place to stay. We wanted to create a destination with a true sense of escape, where guests can experience everything; the region has to offer while still finding the space to slow down, reconnect, and recharge. Inspired by our natural surroundings, every detail has been thoughtfully considered to create an experience where work, downtime and shared moments flow effortlessly together. Ultimately, our ambition is simple: to create a place where balance comes naturally,”* said Francelina Ferreira do Amaral, General Manager.


Business travellers and event organisers will find one of the region's most comprehensive meeting and event offerings. The property features 1,500 square metres of flexible event space, including 14 meeting rooms and the capacity to accommodate up to 400 delegates. Combined with its nature-led environment and convenient accessibility for domestic and international visitors, the property is ideally suited for conferences, corporate retreats, celebrations, and social events.


The opening of Crowne Plaza Paris Marne-la-Vallée further strengthens the brand’s presence across Europe, with 96 hotels and more than 20,400 rooms open across the region, alongside a pipeline of 21 further properties representing more than 4,300 rooms, supporting the brand’s continued evolution as a leader in premium hospitality for travellers seeking seamless integration between work, life and leisure. Crowne Plaza continues to redefine what modern travel looks like, creating welcoming spaces where meaningful connections, memorable experiences and flexible ways of travelling come together. Find out more at[Crowne Plaza Paris Marne-la-Vallée](https://www.ihg.com/crowneplaza/hotels/us/en/magny-le-hongre/parpm/hoteldetail?msockid=38913344074f6fc519562465063e6e98)
